findings.reason: The same generic live-burden and locked-score sentences recur throughout; the strength sentence interpolates propositions into a common scaffold and the limitation sentence adds repeated filler. These are substantive exposition failures as well as word-limit overruns.

findings.fields: All descriptions containing and thereby supplies
findings.reason: The repeated tail adds no source-specific inference and several descriptions terminate with incomplete clauses. The numeric mean of 26 words does not establish meaningful depth.

findings.fields: Three reinforcing-argument body strings using the defense or critique can/could framing
findings.reason: The paragraphs should state their substantive proposals directly instead of describing the act of developing an argument. Keep their distinct inferential substance, source relationships and natural punctuation.

decision: Use one bounded repair per disjoint shard of at most two leaf fields. Do not change any evidence, judgment, score, quotation, role, structure, tag, or other accepted field.
